en: Black-and-white colonial-era postcard showing an outdoor market scene with numerous African people seated on the ground beside piles of goods, likely produce, while others stand around. Several loaded camels with handlers are positioned in the middle distance. Palm trees and simple buildings frame the scene. Printed captions in French and Dutch at the top identify the setting as Belgian Congo, Léopoldville, and describe the camels as pack animals.
